def on_bar_close(state, bar):
    if not bar.is_closed:
        return state
    if state.pos is None:
        return state
    pos = state.pos
    if pos.atr0 is None:
        pos.atr0 = state.clean_atr(bar.index - 1)  # frozen once at entry
    candidate = bar.close - 2.0 * pos.atr0
    pos.stop = max(pos.stop, candidate)  # long: stop only moves up
    pos.peak = max(pos.peak, bar.high)  # peak only increases
    return state
